tldr_zh: TikTok和Apple掀起監管波瀾，OpenAI Claude突破內容限制引關注
tldr_en: TikTok settles privacy lawsuit, Apple cuts jobs, Claude faces content filtering concerns

items.title_zh: Google DeepMind十五年遊戲AI研究成果，與遊戲工作室合作突破應用
items.title_en: Google DeepMind Advances AI Gameplay Through 15-Year Research Partnership with Game Studios
items.summary_zh: Google DeepMind發表十五年來在遊戲AI領域的重要研究成果，涵蓋從Atari到EVE Online等多個遊戲平台。該公司與遊戲工作室合作開發突破性AI遊戲玩法，展示AI在互動娛樂領域的重大進展。
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind showcased 15 years of AI research in gaming, from Atari to EVE Online, partnering with game studios to prototype breakthrough AI gameplay experiences. This represents significant progress in applying AI to interactive entertainment.

items.title_zh: Anthropic Claude模型內容過濾失效，TechCrunch測試揭露安全漏洞
items.title_en: Anthropic's Claude Model Content Filtering Bypassed in TechCrunch Security Tests
items.summary_zh: TechCrunch進行的測試發現，Anthropic旗下Claude Opus 4.6模型的內容過濾機制存在安全漏洞，儘管官方禁止生成性暴露內容，但研究人員無需費力即可繞過限制。此發現引發對AI模型安全邊界的擔憂。
items.summary_en: TechCrunch's testing reveals that Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 content filtering can be bypassed, despite the company's stated prohibition on generating sexually explicit content. The ease of circumventing safety measures raises concerns about AI model guardrails.

items.title_zh: TikTok和解美國兒童隱私訴訟，支付四億美元罰款
items.title_en: TikTok Settles US Children's Privacy Lawsuit with $400 Million Payment
items.summary_zh: TikTok與美國司法部達成和解，因違反《兒童網路隱私保護法》（COPPA）支付四億美元罰款。司法部指控TikTok未經家長同意或通知即蒐集兒童數據。此為應對該公司長期監管挑戰的重要步驟。
items.summary_en: TikTok settled with the US Department of Justice over alleged COPPA violations, paying $400 million. The DOJ alleged TikTok collected children's data without parental notification or consent. This settlement addresses long-standing regulatory concerns.

items.title_zh: Apple裁員超200人，Vision Pro和Siri團隊受影響
items.title_en: Apple Cuts Over 200 Jobs From Vision Pro and Siri Teams
items.summary_zh: Apple宣布裁減超過200名員工，主要涉及Vision Pro和Siri部門。根據Bloomberg報導，Vision Pro遊戲團隊遭「基本關閉」，沉浸式內容團隊也面臨人員縮減。此舉反映Apple對這些策略性項目的重新評估。
items.summary_en: Apple laid off over 200 employees, primarily from Vision Pro and Siri teams. The company largely shuttered its Vision Pro gaming team and reduced its immersive content development team. This reflects Apple's strategic reassessment of these initiatives.

items.title_zh: Walmart正式支援Apple Pay和Google Pay移動支付
items.title_en: Walmart Launches Apple Pay and Google Pay Support Nationwide
items.summary_zh: Walmart宣布從8月24日起在部分店面開始支援Apple Pay和Google Pay等行動支付。公司計畫於2026年底前在所有美國門市推展此功能。此舉將大幅改善消費者的支付便利性。
items.summary_en: Walmart announced support for Apple Pay and Google Pay starting August 24 at select locations, with plans for nationwide rollout by end of 2026. This expands mobile payment options for millions of customers.

items.title_zh: Nvidia與數據中心開發商Cloverleaf達成合作協議
items.title_en: Nvidia Partners with Data Center Developer Cloverleaf for Infrastructure Growth
items.summary_zh: Nvidia繼續加大對數據中心開發的投資，與開發商Cloverleaf建立合作夥伴關係。此舉反映Nvidia在AI數據中心基礎設施領域的持續擴張策略，而AI數據中心的蓬勃發展也為Nvidia帶來了可觀的商業機會。
items.summary_en: Nvidia announced a partnership with data center developer Cloverleaf as it continues investing heavily in data center infrastructure. This reflects Nvidia's strategic expansion in AI data center facilities, which are increasingly lucrative for the company.

items.title_zh: LinkedIn推出AI垃圾內容檢舉按鈕，超百萬用戶點擊
items.title_en: Over 1 Million Users Click LinkedIn's AI-Generated Content Detection Button
items.summary_zh: LinkedIn在7月30日推出「看起來是AI垃圾」的檢舉按鈕，引起廣泛使用。公司首席產品官指出，已有超過百萬用戶點擊此功能。這反映用戶對社交媒體上AI生成內容日益增加的關注。
items.summary_en: LinkedIn's "Seems like AI slop" button, launched July 30, has been clicked by over 1 million users. The company's CPO revealed the high engagement, indicating users' concerns about AI-generated content flooding the platform.

items.title_zh: Google Gemma模型下載破十億次，衍生超十萬個開源模型
items.title_en: Google Gemma AI Model Surpasses 1 Billion Downloads, Spawns 100,000+ Derivative Models
items.summary_zh: Google宣布旗下開放AI模型Gemma系列的累計下載量已突破十億次，開發者在過去兩年內發布了超過十萬個Gemma衍生模型。Google稱此現象為「Gemmaverse」開發者生態，展示其開源AI的廣泛採用。
items.summary_en: Google announced that its Gemma AI model family has surpassed 1 billion downloads with developers creating over 100,000 derivative models. The company calls this thriving ecosystem the "Gemmaverse," demonstrating widespread adoption of its open-source AI.

items.title_zh: 中國要求特斯拉修復近三百萬輛汽車安全隱患
items.title_en: Chinese Regulators Demand Tesla Fix Safety Issues in Nearly 3 Million Vehicles
items.summary_zh: 中國安全監管部門下令特斯拉修復近三百萬輛車的安全缺陷，涉及車門在碰撞時無法開啟的問題。此舉為中國對外國汽車製造商越來越嚴格的監管態度。
items.summary_en: Chinese safety regulators ordered Tesla to fix defects in nearly 3 million vehicles, addressing door failures in crashes. This reflects China's increasingly strict oversight of foreign automotive manufacturers.

items.title_zh: 美國最高法院批准川普白宮宴會廳施工繼續進行
items.title_en: US Supreme Court Permits Trump White House Ballroom Construction to Proceed
items.summary_zh: 美國最高法院裁定暫時允許川普總統繼續興建白宮大型宴會廳項目。川普表示感謝，稱該宴會廳與軍事設施「至關重要」。此決定暫停對該項目的法律挑戰。
items.summary_en: The US Supreme Court ruled to temporarily allow President Trump to continue construction of a new White House ballroom. Trump expressed gratitude, calling the project critical to the administration's operations.

items.title_zh: 俄烏戰爭升溫，莫斯科發動「雙重襲擊」致烏克蘭購物中心14死
items.title_en: Russian Double-Tap Drone Strikes Kill 14 in Ukrainian Shopping Center
items.summary_zh: 俄羅斯無人機對烏克蘭中部城市克利福洛一座購物中心發動先後兩次襲擊，造成至少14人死亡、120多人受傷。此次「雙重襲擊」戰術凸顯俄烏衝突的持續升溫。
items.summary_en: Russian drone strikes targeted a Ukrainian shopping center with successive attacks, killing at least 14 people and injuring over 120. The double-tap tactic highlights the escalating intensity of the Russia-Ukraine conflict.
